row.notes: Renamed from Sess_StoryFail_ApplyLowerDifficultyOption: StoryFail comes only from the caller, the body just steps a difficulty option down by one. Reads the option object at owner+0x2a0 (vcall +0x10 = current value), maps it with Game_ChallengeCareer_FindDifficultyIndex to a byte index, takes index-1 for 1..3 (anything else becomes 3), then either uses that index directly (flag owner+0x2a8 set) or finds the option entry whose name equals the string table 0x14568f940[index] (entries 0x50 apart at option+0x80, range ints at +0xb8/+0xbc, default +0xc0) and applies it with vcall +0x18. Context from caller: Sess_StoryFail_OnRestartChoice calls it on *(this+0xdd0) right before it posts the restart_lower_difficulty bus message; good hook to change the step size. (lab L1 re-check with caller context 2026-11-27)
